activity.notes: A single approximate c.860 representative source-attested point, NOT a reign from 860 to 860 or a claim of exact 860 chronology. Devapala's Nalanda copper-plate grant (39th regnal year) attests Balaputradeva, ruler of Suvarnadvipa; scholarly datings vary roughly 844–860. Association of Suvarnadvipa/Sumatra's Sailendra rulers with Srivijaya must be checked against exact Production polity identity, not treated as a new polity synonym blindly.
